##Loading package----------------------------------------------------------

We load the `Protti` package, along with additional packages for
data manipulation and visualisation.

```{r load_libraries}
library(magrittr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(protti)
```


##Input preparation--------------------------------------------------------
# To read in your own data you can use read_protti()

We load the output from FragPipe output combined_ion.tsv file.

```{r import_data}
evidence_TrP  <- read_protti(filename = "combined_ion_TrP.tsv")
evidence_LiP  <- read_protti(filename = "combined_ion_LiP.tsv")
```

# Filter unique peptides

```{r clean_up_data}
evidence_TrP <- evidence_TrP %>% filter(evidence_TrP$mapped_genes == "")
evidence_LiP <- evidence_LiP %>% filter(evidence_LiP$mapped_genes == "")
```

# Convert wide data format to long data format

```{r convert_data_format}
convert_TrP <- evidence_TrP %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = ends_with("intensity"),
               names_to = "experiment_TrP",
               values_to = "intensity")
convert_LiP <- evidence_LiP %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = ends_with("intensity"),
               names_to = "experiment_LiP",
               values_to = "intensity")
```

# Extract last AA of peptides

```{r extract_info_form_peptides}
convert_TrP$last_aa <- substr(convert_TrP$peptide_sequence, nchar(convert_TrP$peptide_sequence), nchar(convert_TrP$peptide_sequence))
convert_LiP$last_aa <- substr(convert_LiP$peptide_sequence, nchar(convert_LiP$peptide_sequence), nchar(convert_LiP$peptide_sequence))
```

# Assign peptide types

```{r peptide_assignment}
pep_TrP <- convert_TrP %>% 
  assign_peptide_type(
  aa_before = prev_aa,
  last_aa = last_aa,
  aa_after = next_aa
)
pep_LiP <- convert_LiP %>% 
  assign_peptide_type(
  aa_before = prev_aa,
  last_aa = last_aa,
  aa_after = next_aa
)
```


## Output tables-----------------------------------------------------------

```{r output_tables}
write.table(pep_TrP, file = "pep_TrP.txt", sep = "\t",
            row.names = FALSE)
write.table(pep_LiP, file = "pep_LiP.txt", sep = "\t",
            row.names = FALSE)
```
